a retained description draft keeps its original baseline across a pending scan and presentation change

description and credential fields remain locked while their save HTTP requests are pending
a credential draft keeps its original configuration revision through a source-changing snapshot refresh
discovery accepts an explicit executable and remembers configuration-only selection without launching Codex
locked model credentials block sends, unlock in place preserves the draft, and historical failures can be reasked
floating chat sends one question per turn, renders safe Markdown, retains drafts across routes and supports follow-up
minimizing leaves a real streaming request active; stop and refresh preserve partial answer
lost acceptance retries the original idempotency key without a second draft write or model loop
missing-model chat retains local help and does not send a fabricated answer
assistant launcher drags with mouse and touch, docks at either edge, persists and keeps the same conversation

UI-02: recovered successful generation keeps editing locked until its real suite receipt arrives

UI-03: a delayed read of an old suite cannot roll back a newer same-workflow fixture save

testing UI keeps Mock default, Contract catalog-only and Live explicitly scoped through real MCP
testing UI uses configured synthetic Provider for asynchronous AI suite generation and cancel
lost AI acceptance retries its original command after viewing another validation level without another model call
real UI model settings, assistant create/patch, canvas persistence, undo, dirty conflict and Mock selftest
